records.name: React UCheckbox
records.purpose: Controlled native checkbox with true/false value mapping, an optional tooltip and a change event object.
records.surface: UCheckbox is a plain function component, not a forwardRef. UCheckboxProps requires checked:unknown and adds trueValue (default true), falseValue (default false), onChange, disabled, readOnly, invalid, name, value:unknown, id, inputId, inputRef:React.Ref<HTMLInputElement>, tooltip, tooltipOptions:Record<string, unknown>, autoFocus and className. Refs: inputRef (function or object) is merged by setInputRef, which also writes an internalInputRef that is never read; elementRef targets the root div for the tooltip. State is fully controlled: isChecked = checked === trueValue, and handleChange returns without calling onChange when disabled, readOnly or onChange is absent; otherwise it emits UCheckboxChangeEvent {originalEvent, value, checked (the other of trueValue/falseValue), target {type:"checkbox", name, id, value, checked}}. The value prop is only passed into the event, never to the DOM input. The component renders a fragment: a root div (id, cx root with checked, plus className) containing a native input type=checkbox (id=inputId, name, checked, disabled, readOnly, autoFocus, aria-invalid={invalid}) and a box div that holds UCheckIcon from @ultimate/react-core only when checked; there is no label, aria-label or aria-labelledby prop. When tooltip is set, UTooltip from ../tooltip is rendered with target=elementRef and tooltipOptions spread after content. checkboxStyleModule defines classes root (checked), box (checked), input and icon; there is no ClassesParams interface, and no disabled or invalid class. componentName checkbox matches the Aura components registry key checkbox. CHECKBOX_METADATA in packages/component-metadata/src/records/checkbox.ts lists packages/react/src/checkbox/checkbox.tsx as the React source; checkbox.api.mdx is a generated documentation fixture and is excluded. Public runtime and types are named exports from both @ultimate/react and @ultimate/react/checkbox; the root barrel line and manifest subpath are both present. useComponentBase from @ultimate/react-core resolves cx classes and delegates style registration to useComponentStyle; those hooks are external foundation records, not duplicated here. Local style CSS is hand-authored and registered; no scoped style module imports @ultimate/uix-styles. The manifest advertises dist entry/type paths; this does not prove a built or published package.

records.name: React USelectButton
records.purpose: Controlled single or multiple option group built from UToggleButton items with roving keyboard focus.
records.surface: USelectButton<T> is a generic plain function component, not a forwardRef. USelectButtonProps<T> requires value:T, onChange and options:unknown[] and adds optionLabel, optionValue and optionDisabled (each a property-name string or accessor function), multiple (default false), allowEmpty (default true), disabled, className and aria-labelledby; USelectButtonChangeEvent<T> is {originalEvent, value:T}. There are no name, id, invalid, readOnly or fluid props and no ref prop. The module-private resolve helper reads an accessor, a property of an object option, or a fallback. Single mode emits null when the selected option is clicked and allowEmpty is true, and ignores the click when allowEmpty is false; multiple mode filters or appends option values and ignores removing the last value when allowEmpty is false. Selection uses strict equality. Each option renders UToggleButton imported from ../toggle-button/toggle-button with onLabel = offLabel = the option label, checked from isSelected, and disabled from disabled or optionDisabled; the key is label_index. Keyboard: the root div handles ArrowRight/ArrowDown (+1) and ArrowLeft/ArrowUp (-1) by event.code, skips disabled options, wraps, and moves focus to the matching input; it does nothing when the input count differs from options.length. A roving tab stop gives tabIndex 0 to one enabled option. The root div has role="group" and aria-labelledby and its class comes from cx("root", { fluid: false }); invalid is never passed, so the u-select-button-invalid and u-select-button-fluid classes defined by SelectButtonClassesParams and the CSS are never emitted by the component. selectButtonStyleModule is exported alongside the SelectButtonClassesParams interface. componentName select-button differs from the Aura components registry key selectbutton, so registry existence is not proof of token resolution. records.name: React UMultiStateCheckbox
records.purpose: Controlled click-to-cycle control that steps through a list of option values and optionally back to null, exposed as a checkbox with a live announcement.
records.surface: UMultiStateCheckbox<T, V = T> is a generic forwardRef component whose ref is a UMultiStateCheckboxHandle {focus, getElement}. UMultiStateCheckboxProps extends the div HTML attributes (minus onChange, onFocus, onBlur and children) and requires value:V|null and options:T[]; it adds onChange (optional), onFocus, onBlur, optionValue and optionLabel (property-name strings), optionIcon:(option:T)=>React.ReactNode, empty (default true), disabled, readOnly, invalid, variant (filled or outlined), name, autoFocus, nullLabel (default Not Selected), unstyled, pt and ptOptions. UMultiStateCheckboxChangeEvent<V> is {originalEvent, value:V|null, stopPropagation, preventDefault, target:{name, id, value}}. State is fully controlled: the selected index is found by strict equality, and toggle (skipped when disabled or readOnly, for both click and Space) advances to the next option; after the last option it emits null when empty is true and the first option when empty is false; when no option matches it advances to the first option. records.name: React UTriStateCheckbox
records.purpose: Controlled true/false/null checkbox that cycles states on click, label activation, Space, Enter or NumpadEnter.
records.surface: UTriStateCheckbox is a forwardRef component whose ref is a UTriStateCheckboxHandle {focus, getElement}. UTriStateCheckboxProps extends the div HTML attributes (minus onChange, onFocus, onBlur and children) and requires value:boolean|null; it adds onChange, onFocus, onBlur, disabled, readOnly, invalid, variant (filled or outlined), name, inputId, autoFocus, checkIcon, uncheckIcon, trueLabel, falseLabel, nullLabel, unstyled, pt and ptOptions; tabIndex defaults to 0. State is fully controlled and has no internal state: any value other than true or false is treated as null, and cycle (skipped when disabled or readOnly) emits UTriStateCheckboxChangeEvent {originalEvent, value, stopPropagation, preventDefault, target:{name, id, value}} following null -> true -> false -> null. Box click, label activation of the hidden input, and Enter, NumpadEnter and Space (read from event.code, with preventDefault) all cycle. Markup inside the root div (cx root with disabled, invalid and variantFilled, plus data-p-disabled while disabled): a hidden native input type=checkbox (id=inputId, name, checked={value === true}, readOnly, disabled, aria-hidden, tabIndex=-1, onChange cycles, onFocus moves focus to the box, pointer-events none in CSS); a span with className u-hidden-accessible and aria-live="polite" whose text is trueLabel, falseLabel or nullLabel (defaults True, False and Not Selected); and a box div with role="checkbox", aria-checked "true"/"false"/"mixed", aria-invalid, tabIndex, the click, key, focus and blur handlers and every forwarded aria-* prop, showing checkIcon or UCheckIcon for true and uncheckIcon or UTimesIcon for false. records.name: React URating
records.purpose: Controlled star rating row with pointer and keyboard selection, pointer clearing, an optional cancel item, an invalid state, custom icons and pass-through.
records.surface: URating is a forwardRef component whose handle URatingHandle exposes getElement(). URatingProps extends the div HTML attributes without onChange and children and adds value (number|null, default null), onChange, stars (default 5), readOnly, disabled, invalid, cancel (default false), name, onIcon, offIcon and cancelIcon (URatingIcon: a class string rendered on a span, an element cloned with the icon props, or a function of the icon props), onIconProps, offIconProps, cancelIconProps, unstyled, pt and ptOptions. URatingChangeEvent is {originalEvent, value:number|null, stopPropagation, preventDefault, target:{name, id, value}}. Every other prop, including onFocus and onBlur, is merged onto the root div with role="group" and the pt root section. State is controlled plus internal focusedOptionIndex and isFocusVisibleItem state and a pointerDown ref. Changes are emitted only when enabled = !disabled && !readOnly. Per star a div with role="radio", aria-checked={value === starValue}, aria-label "1 star" or "N stars", aria-invalid when invalid, tabIndex 0 when enabled and none when disabled or read-only, data-p-focused, cx item (u-rating-option with u-rating-option-active and p-focus-visible) and the pt item section with the context { active }. Its icon is the custom onIcon or offIcon, or an aria-hidden 14 by 14 svg with the PrimeIcons star-fill or star path from rating-icons.ts (RATING_STAR_PATH and RATING_STAR_FILL_PATH; the cancel item uses RATING_BAN_PATH), merged with the onIcon or offIcon pt section and icon props; the icons carry p-invalid when invalid. Keyboard per star: Enter and Space select that star; ArrowLeft and ArrowUp step to (value ?? 0) - 1, wrapping to stars below 1; ArrowRight and ArrowDown step to (value ?? 0) + 1, wrapping to 1 above stars. The keyboard never clears. A pointer click on the selected star emits null; any other click selects. The focus ring shows only for keyboard focus, through the pointerDown ref set on mouse down. With cancel, a cancel item (role="button", aria-label "Clear", cx cancelItem, pt cancelItem) renders before the stars with the cancelIcon or the PrimeIcons ban svg, and emits null on click, Enter or Space. ratingStyleModule is a StyleModule with classes root, item, onIcon, offIcon, cancelItem and cancelIcon, and its CSS is the shared @ultimate/uix-styles/rating module on the Aura rating tokens. componentName rating matches the Aura components registry key rating. createPassThrough('rating') and useMergeProps from @ultimate/react-core build the pass-through; useComponentBase resolves cx and registers the style. records.name: React USlider
records.purpose: Controlled single-handle or two-handle range slider with mouse and touch drag, keyboard stepping, an invalid state, pass-through and an optional slide-end callback.
records.surface: USlider is a React.forwardRef function component; the ref is the root div element. USliderProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> (without onChange and defaultValue), requires value:number|number[] and onChange, and adds min (default 0), max (default 100), step (no default), range (default false), orientation "horizontal"|"vertical" (default horizontal), disabled, invalid, tabIndex (default 0), className, onSlideEnd, unstyled, pt and ptOptions; USliderChangeEvent is {originalEvent: Event|React.SyntheticEvent, value:number|number[]}. aria-label and aria-labelledby are forwarded to the handles; every other attribute goes to the root. State is fully controlled, and the latest props are read through a ref so drag callbacks never use a stale value. Value is read by type, not by the range flag: an array gives the pair (otherwise [min, max]) and a number gives the single value (otherwise min). snapToStep applies Prime's rule relative to the current value (floor when step is falsy); updateValue rounds with toFixed(10), clamps and, in range mode, copies the array and replaces the active handle. onMouseDown and onTouchStart (skipped when disabled) focus the handle and add document mousemove and mouseup, or touchmove, touchend and touchcancel, listeners that are removed when the drag ends and when the component unmounts; touch follows the identifier that started the drag. The pointer is mirrored when the element direction is rtl, a zero-size track is ignored, and max less than or equal to min gives 0 per cent. onSlideEnd reports the latest value at the end of a drag and after a bar click, which ignores the click that follows a drag and clicks on role=slider elements and picks the nearest handle in range mode. Keyboard (event.key): ArrowDown/ArrowLeft subtract step, ArrowUp/ArrowRight add step (step ?? 1), PageDown/PageUp change by ten steps, Home sets min, End sets max. Handles are span elements with role="slider", tabIndex (removed when disabled), aria-valuemin, aria-valuenow (the actual value), aria-valuemax and aria-orientation, placed with inset-inline-start (horizontal) or bottom (vertical); there is no aria-disabled. Pass-through sections are root, range, handle, startHandler and endHandler through createPassThrough and useMergeProps; unstyled drops the Ultimate classes. sliderStyleModule is exported with the SliderClassesParams interface (orientation, disabled, invalid); classes root, range, handle. componentName slider matches the Aura components registry key slider. Public runtime and types are named exports from both @ultimate/react and @ultimate/react/slider; the root barrel line and manifest subpath are both present. useComponentBase from @ultimate/react-core resolves cx classes and delegates style registration to useComponentStyle; those hooks are external foundation records, not duplicated here. The CSS is the shared @ultimate/uix-styles/slider module (ADR-082, ADR-101). The manifest advertises dist entry/type paths; this does not prove a built or published package.

records.name: React UKnob
records.purpose: Controlled circular SVG dial adjusted by click, drag and keyboard.
records.surface: UKnob is a plain function component, not a forwardRef; index.ts exports only UKnob and UKnobProps (no change-event type). UKnobProps requires value:number and onChange(value: number) which receives a bare number, not an event object, and adds size (100), min (0), max (100), step (1), strokeWidth (14), showValue (true), readOnly, disabled, valueTemplate ("{value}"), valueColor ("#3B82F6"), rangeColor ("#D1D5DB"), textColor ("#374151") and className. There is no name, id or aria-label prop and no ref prop; an internal svgRef is used only for pointer geometry. State is fully controlled. updateModelValue clamps to [min, max] before onChange. Click maps event.nativeEvent.offsetX and offsetY to an angle; mousedown adds document mousemove and mouseup listeners (removed on mouseup, no unmount cleanup) and uses svg getBoundingClientRect. Keyboard (event.code): ArrowRight/ArrowUp add step, ArrowLeft/ArrowDown subtract step, Home sets min, End sets max, PageUp and PageDown change by a fixed 10 regardless of step. The enabled flag (!disabled && !readOnly) gates the handlers. Markup: a root div (cx root only, so disabled and readOnly are not reflected in a class) around an svg with role="slider", width and height equal to size, viewBox 0 0 100 100, tabIndex 0 when enabled else -1, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax and aria-valuenow; there is no aria-label, aria-labelledby, aria-disabled or aria-readonly. Two paths draw the range and value arcs, and an optional text element shows valueTemplate with {value} replaced. The source header comment states touch handling is excluded; no touch handling exists. knobStyleModule is exported; classes root (plain string), range, value, text; there is no ClassesParams interface. componentName knob matches the Aura components registry key knob. Public runtime and types are named exports from both @ultimate/react and @ultimate/react/knob; the root barrel line and manifest subpath are both present. useComponentBase from @ultimate/react-core resolves cx classes and delegates style registration to useComponentStyle; those hooks are external foundation records, not duplicated here. Local style CSS is hand-authored and registered; no scoped style module imports @ultimate/uix-styles. The manifest advertises dist entry/type paths; this does not prove a built or published package.
